idea-plugin.name: Maekom Mongo Lens
idea-plugin.description:
Maekom Mongo Lens provides a Zero-Config MongoDB Compass-style GUI directly inside IntelliJ IDEA Community & Ultimate.

  • Zero-Config Spring Boot YAML Discovery: Automatically parses single & multi-document application*.yml files, resolves ${VAR:default} placeholders and .env, and protects PRD environments with Read-Only lock.
  • Compass-Style Query Workspace: Multi-tab Find workspace with Filter/Project/Sort JSON editors, field auto-completion, instant Limit stepping, Smart $in builder, Mongo Shell normalizer, and Tree / Raw JSON / Table viewers with index scan badges.
  • Bidirectional Aggregation Pipeline Builder: Switch seamlessly between visual stage cards (with per-stage ON/OFF toggles & 5-doc stage preview) and raw JSON script.
  • In-App GitHub Releases Updater & Real-time KO/EN UI: Check and install updates from GitHub Releases and toggle Korean/English without restarting the IDE.
